product_launches.description: TEMPO Outdoor plans to launch its new Double-Top Umbrella V2, a compact sibling to its Maximus M2 commercial umbrella platform, previewing it at the 139th Canton Fair 2026 Phase 2 before full commercial rollout later in 2026.

overview_description.description:
Tempo designs and develops a home fitness platform with personal guidance to help users in their training sessions. It features live elite trainers who can help users when they make mistakes. It has built-in three-dimensional sensors that track form, counts reps, and recommend weights. It helps users to improve in real-time. Powered by 3D motion sensors and AI, it analyzes 25 of the body’s essential joints as users work out and gives understood form feedback. 

Moawia Eldeeb and Joshua Augustin founded it as Pivot in 2015, with its headquarters in San Francisco in California.

about_short_description.short_description: Tempo is a home fitness platform, combining equipment, training guidance, and social motivation with 3D sensors and artificial intelligence.

product.name: Tempo Fitness Platform
product.description: A home fitness platform that combines guided workouts, adaptive training plans, performance tracking, and social motivation through connected equipment, 3D sensing, and artificial intelligence.

product.name: Virtual Personal Training
product.description: A membership service providing guided, instructor-led home workouts with scheduling, reminders, personalized adjustments, and training plans for different fitness goals and physical needs.

product.name: Tempo Home Gym Equipment
product.description: Connected home-fitness equipment, including smart color-coded weights, designed to provide real-time exercise tracking and guidance during strength and conditioning workouts.

product.name: 3D Body Scan and Progress Tracking
product.description: A digital assessment and tracking capability that uses 3D body scans and workout performance data to monitor changes in body fat, muscle mass, and related fitness metrics.
